context: Sho tells Yumiko about working hard at school.
purpose: Casual home register; vocabulary (一生懸命/がんばっ/取り組ん/経費/役員) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日、一生懸命がんばったよ!
lines.en: Mom, I worked really hard today!
lines.style: excited small child voice, bright warm bouncing delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: えらいわね。何に取り組んだの?
lines.en: Good job. What did you work on?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 係の仕事に、取り組んだんだ。
lines.en: I worked on my class duty.
lines.style: proud small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: クラスの役員に、なったのね。
lines.en: You became a class officer, then.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、役員ってちょっと大変だよ。
lines.en: Yeah, being an officer is a bit hard.
lines.style: earnest small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でも、一生懸命がんばってるのね。
lines.en: But you're giving it your all.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 行事の経費も、みんなで考えたよ!
lines.en: We thought about the event expenses together too!
lines.style: cheerful small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: すごいわ。これからもがんばってね。
lines.style: tender mother voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
